name: Demi
doc: Demi (the spell): the root - every 45 ticks the target task of the next action on its first target: motes circling in, two sprite sequences, a screen fade, the target hidden and drawn as a silhouette pulled towards its middle, the vortex's prim-model play with its orbs and sparks, the sound; the status. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag107_demi.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Target
parts.doc: One target task an action on its first target: the motes, two sprite sequences, the screen fade, the target drawn as a silhouette pulled towards its middle, the vortex with its orbs and sparks, the sound; the status

params.label: Status tick
